purpose: Classify routeKeys that are not yet closed across Skill, KnowledgeIndex and AIBrain.

aibrainOnlyReview.decisionRule: knowledgeCandidate requires a canonical KnowledgeIndex entry and requiredReads before remaining a user-facing AIBrain route; removeOrKeepInternal must not be used as a user route and should be removed from AIBrain unless a control-plane contract explicitly consumes it. Duplicate names in both lists are an audit error and must be resolved before release.

dispositionMeaning.promote: Add to a canonical KnowledgeIndex/AIBrain function-area route because it changes cross-domain discovery.
dispositionMeaning.internal: Keep as Skill-internal implementation or evidence vocabulary; do not expose as a standalone user route.
dispositionMeaning.promote-to-knowledge: Retain AIBrain route and add KnowledgeIndex support so the route is not orphaned.
dispositionMeaning.promote-to-aibrain: Expose an existing Skill+Knowledge route in the AIBrain function-area table after requiredReads and authority are confirmed.
dispositionMeaning.skill-domain-only: Keep discoverable through the Skill registry only; do not expose as a cross-domain AIBrain route.
dispositionMeaning.remove-or-keep-internal: Do not route user work directly; either remove the AIBrain row or bind it to a control-plane Knowledge contract.
